title: Down the edge of the paper
html_source: The ‘Freeman’s journal’ carried obituaries at the top of the left-hand column on page one. The names Bloom reads do not appear in the 16 June 1904 edition, and none seems to have any significance except momentarily Peake, who is mentioned as “hounded…out of the office” in “Counterparts,” ‘Dubliners.’
